displayName: The Walking Dead: The Telltale Definitive Series - Steam build 5952618
installPaths: F:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\The Walking Dead The Telltale Definitive Series

engine.note: The launcher executable reports product GameApp 1.0.0.1 and a file version of 2019.11.25.83, so this is the late 2019 collection build of the same engine family as The Final Season rather than the 2012 Season 1 build.

installEvidence.reading: On the first reading this app was registered but not downloaded (buildid 0, SizeOnDisk 0, StateFlags 1026, empty folder). It was then installed on the same machine and now reports StateFlags 4 with 48,816,593,394 bytes on disk, eight top level entries and a populated Archives folder, so this profile replaces the earlier blocked record.

content.archiveLayout: flat: every archive sits directly in Archives with no per-episode directories, unlike Seasons 1 to 4

episodeDirectories.106: Season 1 extra episode code, the slot 400 Days occupies in Telltale packaging

content.evidence: Episode codes come from archive names: WDC_pc_WalkingDead1NN for Season 1, 2NN and 3NN for the later seasons, and WD4_PC_4NN plus per-language WD4_*_4NN sets for Season 4. Counts per code were tallied from the 480 file names on this machine. Season 4 titles are carried over from the standalone The Final Season profile. Code 106 is the extra Season 1 episode slot that holds 400 Days; no title string was read to confirm it, and nothing was played to confirm any mapping.
content.note: This install carries 400 Days content, which the standalone Season 1 install on this machine does not have.

steamDrm.evidence: WDC.exe sits beside steam_api64.dll and the app is delivered through Steam.
steamDrm.policy: Never bypassed. Steam Offline Mode with a cached licence is the supported offline path.

publisherServices.evidence: String literals inside WDC.exe, read on this machine. services.telltalegames.com appears twice in ASCII, once bare and once with the /1/syncfs/ path. www.telltalegames.com appears only as UTF-16 text inside the sign-in help sentence, so it is a help or store link, not a startup call. The other hostnames in the binary belong to bundled libraries (curl, OpenSSL, Box2D, Lua, Microsoft) and were excluded.
publisherServices.runtimeObservation: Not observed. No packet capture or netstat sample was taken while this build was running.

onlineDependencies.unexplainedString: WDC.exe carries the UTF-16 sentence 'To unlock your game, log in with your Telltale e-mail address and password.' No login gate was exercised, and it is not known whether this build shows it or whether it is a leftover resource. If a sign-in prompt does appear offline, that is a separate problem from the launch wait and is not addressed by this patch.

launchMeasurement.conditions: patch installed (WantsOfflineMode 1, SkipOfflineModeWarning 1, services.telltalegames.com pinned to 127.0.0.1) with Steam's Offline Mode active and outbound blocked for steam.exe, steamwebhelper.exe and WDC.exe
launchMeasurement.clock: starts when steam://rungameid/1449690 is handed to Steam
launchMeasurement.samples: frame sequence at about 1.6 s intervals; screens identified by their own signatures, not by click differences
launchMeasurement.menuAcceptanceEvidence: a click on Season Select opened the season chooser carousel with a PLAY button
launchMeasurement.usableDefinition: the collection's main menu is rendered and accepts a click, which is where a season is chosen and played
launchMeasurement.unpatchedComparison: Not measured on this build. The no-patch comparison exists for Season 1 only: doc 19 condition C, no game process in 220 s under the same cut-off.

verified: the installed executable matches the sha256 this patch is written for, so the patch applies to this build only
the publisher endpoint was located as a string literal in the shipped WDC.exe
installing and removing the endpoint pin is byte-reversible: the same mechanics are covered for the shared tool by tests/Run-Tests.ps1, including the two-game merge and the last-removal restore
an offline launch with the patch installed reached the main menu at 18.54 s and that menu accepted a click that opened the season chooser
untested: the same run without the patch on this build: the unpatched cut-off measurement exists for Season 1 only
a machine with no network adapter at all; the cut-off used scoped firewall rules
whether the launcher's own season selector needs anything beyond services.telltalegames.com
the sign-in sentence recorded above: no prompt appeared during the measured launch, but the string is still in the binary
gameplay, saves and achievements offline on this build
offlinePatch.crossReference: The launch fix itself is Steam's own Offline Mode switch, first measured on Season 1 in docs/rea/19-offline-launch-stall.md (condition D: usable frontend at 11.63 s with the client and game cut off, against no launch in 220 s without it). It is a client-wide setting, not a per-game one.
